stem_book: The centre of mass of a uniform solid object which is formed by rotating a parabola x = ky² about the X-axis (vertex at the origin), having height of the object 6 m along the X-axis, is given by (α m, β m). Find (α + β).
reason: added 'uniform solid' (figure shows a filled paraboloid; a hollow shell would give a different answer)
work: solid paraboloid: x_cm = ∫x·πy²dx/∫πy²dx = ∫x²dx/∫x dx = (2/3)·6 = 4, y = 0 → α + β = 4
